builder.objective: V2-02 — Réalisations, chrono et historique. Build the transactional heart of ChoreScore: CompletedEntry with Fait par/Fait pour, manual/chrono duration, PersistentTask (optional, = Score filter), history under 'Ajouter une tâche', navigation Ajouter | Score | To-do, modification/deletion, local persistence. Free shows current civil month only; Trial/Standard/Pro show full archive. No CompletedEntry deleted on month change or downgrade.
builder.scope: Greenfield slice: domain CompletedEntry/PersistentTask entities, use-cases for entry creation/listing/deletion, UI screens (Ajouter une tâche with chrono toggle, entry form, history list), PersistentTask as Score filter placeholder, local persistence. Prepare analytical normalization of labels (text stays free in product, but no future research data must depend on raw text export).
acceptance: CompletedEntry created with label, performedByMemberId, beneficiaryMemberIds[], duration, household, date/time, optional persistentTaskId
Fait par defaults to connected user, changeable to any household member
Fait pour allows 'Tout le monde' or any non-empty subset of members
Two duration modes: manual input and chrono (1 real minute = 1 minute)
PersistentTask optional: creates Score filter, does not create entries
History shows current civil month in Free mode
History shows full archive in Trial/Standard/Pro mode
No CompletedEntry destroyed on month change or downgrade
Modification and deletion of entries possible
Local persistence and chrono resume work
npm run check green, no regressions in V2-00/V2-01
previousCriteriaPreserved: V2-01: identity, households, subscription, Options, trial expiry, demo-premium consistency
